digest.overview: Quiet Saturday window dominated by AI's downstream effects: education defenses against cheating, data center pollution fights, scraper overload on open infra, and lingering Hugging Face/OpenAI incident details. Local tooling and agent experiments continue in parallel.

top_story.headline: Denmark mandates oral defenses for student work to counter AI cheating
top_story.summary: New policy requires in-person oral exams for written assignments amid rising AI use in schools.
top_story.why_it_matters: Direct policy response to generative AI in education; first national-scale shift from written-only assessment.

sentiment.label: mixed
sentiment.summary: Community notes practical pushback on AI misuse (cheating, scraping, pollution) alongside continued local experimentation and agent hype.

influencer_takes.author: Ethan Mollick
influencer_takes.quote: Seriously, I don’t think you can watch this video without realizing: 1) AI has gotten very smart 2) The smartness of individual AIs is not the limiting factor because individual instances spontaneously cooperate
influencer_takes.context: Highlights emergent multi-agent behavior as the real capability jump.

research_radar.headline: KADATH: Evolutionary multi-agent runtime on GitHub

research_radar.headline: Gentoo bugzilla closed due to AI bot scraper overload
research_radar.summary: Open source infrastructure strained by automated crawlers, mirroring broader data ingestion pressures.

post_ideas.hook: Denmark just killed the take-home essay
post_ideas.draft: Denmark requiring oral defenses for all written student work to beat AI cheating. First major national policy shift on assessment integrity.
post_ideas.why_viral: Clear policy action with immediate classroom implications; taps into ongoing education + AI debate.

post_ideas.hook: Amazon's new Texas plant could be America's dirtiest single power source
post_ideas.draft: To run one West Texas data center, Amazon is backing a gas plant projected as one of the largest US GHG emitters. NYT via Verge.
post_ideas.why_viral: Direct contradiction of clean-AI narrative with hard pollution numbers and corporate name.

post_ideas.hook: Open source infra buckling under AI scrapers
post_ideas.draft: Gentoo bugzilla shut down from AI bot overload. Same week we get the full OpenAI-Hugging Face accidental attack timeline from Simon Willison.
post_ideas.why_viral: Concrete example of scraping costs hitting maintainers; pairs two timely infra stories.
